description: This file declares the interface for progress reporting in a version control system, including functions for starting, stopping, and displaying progress indicators, as well as test-related external variables and functions.

methods.name: display_throughput
methods.description: Displays throughput information based on the progress structure and total data processed.

methods.name: display_progress
methods.description: Displays progress based on the progress structure and current count.

methods.name: start_progress
methods.description: Initializes and starts a progress indicator for a repository with a specific title and total work amount.

methods.name: start_sparse_progress
methods.description: Starts a sparse progress indicator for the repository.

methods.name: start_delayed_progress
methods.description: Starts a delayed progress indicator for the repository.

methods.name: start_delayed_sparse_progress
methods.description: Starts a sparse, delayed progress indicator.

methods.name: stop_progress_msg
methods.description: Stops the progress indicator and outputs a message.

methods.name: void stop_progress(struct progress ** p_progress)
methods.description: Inline function to stop progress with a default 'done' message.
